# noderings_marketplace_providers (Data Source)

The marketplace's provider directory, sorted by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "noderings_marketplace_providers" "vm" {
  asset_type = "virtual_machine"
}

output "providers" {
  value = data.noderings_marketplace_providers.vm.providers[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `asset_type` (String) Only providers selling `virtual_machine` or `game_server`.
- `search` (String) Only providers whose name contains this text.

### Read-Only

- `providers` (Attributes List) Providers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers))

<a id="nestedatt--providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `providers`

Read-Only:

- `capabilities` (List of String) Platform features.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `id` (String) Provider ID.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `platform_driver` (String) Platform.
- `rating` (Number) Average rating (0-5).
- `total_reviews` (Number) Number of reviews.
